subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw publish this MemoryRerankProvider SDK API plus memoryRerankProviders manifest contract as the supported pre-MMR memory rerank seam?
rationale: This is an additive but public plugin contract; automation cannot choose the permanent SDK shape, registry exclusivity model, qmd scope, or whether the competing external-reranker approach should be canonical.

options.title: Approve this seam after rebase
options.body: Land the vendor-neutral pre-MMR rerank provider API with exclusive registration and qmd excluded for v1 after the branch preserves current-main behavior and focused checks pass.

options.title: Revise the public contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a different capability gate, keyed/config-selected registry, qmd hook, or renamed API before exposing it to plugin authors.

options.title: Pause in favor of plugin-only direction
options.body: Do not publish a new core SDK seam now and instead pursue the concrete external-reranker plugin/config approach or a ClawHub plugin path.

recommendation.title: Approve this seam after rebase
recommendation.body: Land the vendor-neutral pre-MMR rerank provider API with exclusive registration and qmd excluded for v1 after the branch preserves current-main behavior and focused checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available history signal on the memory architecture and plugin SDK boundary that determines the public API direction.
